active_directory.Description:
Specifies the Active Directory policy to be used. Format: 'projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/activeDirectories/{{name}}'.
The policy needs to be in the same location as the storage pool.

capacity_gib.Description: Capacity of the storage pool (in GiB).

description.Description: An optional description of this resource.

effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

encryption_type.Description: Reports if volumes in the pool are encrypted using a Google-managed encryption key or CMEK.

kms_config.Description:
Specifies the CMEK policy to be used for volume encryption. Format: 'projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/kmsConfigs/{{name}}'.
The policy needs to be in the same location as the storage pool.

labels.Description:
Labels as key value pairs. Example: '{ "owner": "Bob", "department": "finance", "purpose": "testing" }'.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

ldap_enabled.Description:
When enabled, the volumes uses Active Directory as LDAP name service for UID/GID lookups. Required to enable extended group support for NFSv3,
using security identifiers for NFSv4.1 or principal names for kerberized NFSv4.1.

location.Description: Name of the location. Usually a region name, expect for some STANDARD service level pools which require a zone name.

name.Description: The resource name of the storage pool. Needs to be unique per location.

service_level.Description: Service level of the storage pool. Possible values: ["PREMIUM", "EXTREME", "STANDARD"]

terraform_labels.Description:
The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
 and default labels configured on the provider.

volume_capacity_gib.Description: Size allocated to volumes in the storage pool (in GiB).

volume_count.Description: Number of volume in the storage pool.
